mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, revision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_version (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{targetDate}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE project_version SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, target_date = #{targetDate}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE project_version SET status = 'released', released_at = #{publishedOn}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status <> 'released'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_version WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
